name: drive-to-delivery
job: Drive one accepted multi-phase objective (engineering or product) to its delivery terminal with evidence at the active delivery boundary.

inScope: Running research, execute, verify, and repair/replan loops until terminal
Landing source via one revert-safe complete PR outcome per objective
Recording honest blockers when the terminal cannot be met
Product-objective mode when the terminal is current evidence
outOfScope: Open-ended product betterment without an accepted objective

inputs: One accepted multi-phase objective and acceptance map
Workspace ownership and host continuity bindings
outputs: Objective at its delivery terminal with checkpoint evidence
One revert-safe complete PR outcome per independent outcome
Honest blocker record if terminal is unreachable

tools: CI and delivery tooling for the active boundary
permissions: delivery authority owned by the active profile

failureSemantics: Claiming done on local green, a queued PR, or an unverified milestone is a failure; the loop continues until terminal evidence at the active delivery boundary exists or an honest blocker is recorded.

outcome.observable: The accepted objective reaches its delivery terminal with evidence at the active delivery boundary (landed or live as required), or a recorded honest blocker, with checkpoint evidence in the primary job output.
